name: Hotel Barriere Le Majestic Cannes
insider_take: Where legendary glamour meets the sparkling French Riviera – this iconic palace has been the heart of Cannes' most prestigious moments since 1926.
whats_special: Hotel Barriere Le Majestic stands as the last remaining grand palace hotel on La Croisette, having hosted countless film stars during the Cannes Film Festival. Its private beach was the first in Cannes, and the hotel's Art Deco façade is protected as a historical monument. The rooftop restaurant offers panoramic views of the Bay of Cannes and the Lérins Islands.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing La Croisette during the Film Festival season – many rooms feature the exact balconies where iconic photographs of Hollywood legends were taken.
dont_miss: The hotel's private pier for yacht arrivals, afternoon tea in the legendary Bar L'Amiral (where Grace Kelly once held court), and a sunset cocktail on the seventh-floor terrace overlooking the Mediterranean. The nearby Palais des Festivals is just a 3-minute walk for that famous red carpet experience.
pros: Prime beachfront location on La Croisette with direct beach access
Iconic Art Deco architecture and legendary Cannes Film Festival glamour
Michelin-starred dining and rooftop terrace with panoramic Mediterranean views
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with premium treatments
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive Cannes location
High-traffic tourist area during festival season and peak summer months
